characters.description: PODRO, hero, 24: face identity MUST match canonical face in reference 01 (upper-right face of the texture atlas), narrow long oval face, slightly protruding ears, straight long nose, close thin lips, modest chin stubble and short dark brown hair. Do not turn him into a generic square-jawed gangster. Short, extremely broad shoulders/back, thick hands, forward hunch, raised shoulders. Black standing-collar jacket over dark sweater, headphones around neck. His RIGHT hand holds a worn wooden-handled metalworker hammer, head down; LEFT hand holds a blank white plastic shopping bag. Eyes down and to the side, never looking at viewer, tired sullen unreadable.

PODRINA: thin pale adult woman, dark eye bags, dark messy hair bun with a pencil through it, oversized BLACK fully covering hoodie, sleeves rolled, no cleavage. Smartphone with a plain muted blue lit screen and blank white sticker in one hand; bitten block of dry instant noodles in other. Chin up, crooked sly smirk, direct narrowed-eyed stare.

CAPTAIN PYLYPCHUK: fat, reddish sweaty-looking face represented with flat muted skin colors (no shine), small moustache, double chin, HUGE Soviet militia peaked cap, too-tight grey-blue uniform. Makarov pistol held upright beside face; blank brown briefcase handcuffed to other wrist. Paranoid sideways eye glance. No uniform text, badges with letters, stars or numbers.

SERHIY: hulking broad shoulders, shaved head, thick neck, stubble, dirty-white sleeveless undershirt, hairy shoulder indicated with few ink marks, simple sugar-bowl tattoo on forearm. Hugging a SIX-LITRE plain plastic water jug. Smug superior grin.

BABA VALYA: very short round grandmother, about 70, cold heavy godfather stare. RED rose-print headscarf, black leather coat with dull brown mink collar over a house robe, spectacles hanging on chain, rings, faint smirk showing two flat dull gold front teeth. Sunflower seeds in palm and a husk on lip. The ONLY saturated red garment.

TOLIK: balding 40-year-old mechanic, distinctive HORSESHOE moustache, dusty slate-blue work overalls open over a striped sailor shirt, welding GOGGLES on forehead (not a full mask), oily blackened forearms, dirty rag on shoulder, arms crossed, grim direct stare.

TARAS: chanson radio host, slicked high quiff, DARK SUNGLASSES over eyes, broad-shouldered 1990s dark leather jacket, thick muted ochre chain over sweater. Holding a corded actual microphone whose unplugged cable hangs. Self-satisfied restrained face.

EDIK: lean wiry short buzz-cut café owner, navy T-shirt, coffee-stained dull brown barista apron (stains as 1–2 flat color shapes, no texture), pencil behind ear, irritated knit-brow frown as if explaining something again. Holds a GOLD-ORANGE instant coffee tin with a completely blank label. Tin is the principal golden accent.

KIBER: thin hunched technician, messy dark hair, glasses with ONE cracked lens, black sweatshirt with a small abstract fictional anime-girl shirt print drawn in this SAME flat ink language (poster faces themselves are not anime). Exactly THREE charging cables around his neck like a scarf, plain ends no letters. Bandaged hands clutch a laptop to chest, suspicious brow.

TALL PETRO: clearly tallest but skinny and slightly stooped, tucked muted brown/olive plaid flannel shirt, holding a plain metal tea thermos. Long narrow head, calm half-closed eyes facing viewer, eerily serene.
PAN HRANITNYI: 60-year-old clean-shaven oligarch, silver hair, dirty-white suit, muted pink granite chunk pendant (not a bright accent), hands behind back, faint polite smile and icy direct eyes.

BARISTA: thin adult man, long dull dark leather apron, welding MASK flipped up on forehead (distinct from Tolik's goggles), big headphones, open singing mouth. Holds an espresso coffee PORTAFILTER by mouth like a microphone; recognizable circular filter basket, not a regular microphone.

edits.prompt:

Input 2 is the GTA III 2001 style reference: emulate its extreme SIMPLICITY of flat ink artwork, NOT its characters. Input 3 is canonical Podro FACE identity (the large upper-right face on the atlas). Input 4 is Podro game clothing only. This must look like old GTA III cast art, not a detailed comic book: TWO FLAT SOLID tones per surface only, broad hard shadow shapes, a few decisive thin interior ink lines, thick consistent black outlines. Remove ALL hatching, hair-strand rendering, skin stubble texture, hairy-arm speckles, fabric texture, metal shine, reflections, tiny mechanical details, soft transitions and gradients. Use large flat black beard/moustache shadow shapes or a few simple marks instead of dots/hatching.
